title: Chapter 6537: A Hoof

Chapter 6537: A Hoof

Chapter 6537: A Hoof

“The palace of an immortal...” Everyone became startled.

Although this energy seeped out of the palace itself, it was more than enough to intimidate everyone. Primal ancestors and heaven-slayers felt insignificant all the same.

“Bao Pu was hiding here, so it’s true.” Everyone gazed at the ethereal palace and believed Xian Chengtian.

Although the light was not overly bright, it forced many to kneel on the ground.

“Bam!” Something gigantic appeared before the palace, blocking the prying beam from illuminating the secret location.

Everyone thought it was Bao Pu at first before taking a closer look - it was a strange monster with the body of a true dragon but was smaller. It had draconic scales, seemingly unbreakable. Its head was humanoid, hidden by the scales.

This hybrid looked foreign to spectators - a species never seen before. Or perhaps it wasn’t natural, just an abomination created from a terrifying method.

“Kill it!” The commanders began the attack.

“Raa!” The dragon hybrid wielded a halberd with a crescent blade and swung vertically.

Greatbones God met it with his golden blade and dao; Summit Ancestor chanted and summoned a great primal mountain; Skynet Demoness utilized her auspicious clouds to help stop the dragon hybrid...

However, its power shocked everyone. The divine treasures couldn’t break its scales while its swing sent everyone flying while vomiting blood.

“Suppress!” Skyfire Phoenix became one with the legion’s formation. Her halberd became gigantic to meet the onslaught.

Spectators thought her halberd had reached the immortal level while feeling a sharp pain in their chest.

Alas, the creature’s scales glowed brightly and stopped the thrust. Embers and shockwaves splashed everywhere, reducing any emperors and desolate gods nearby into blood.

It roared and repelled the halberd with its weapon. It didn’t stop there and summoned a raging inferno. It smashed fiercely, seemingly empowered by an immortal.

It unleashed shockwaves with each swing, breaking the seal around Corpse Wasteland. The formation faltered since an immortal power was being channeled through this creature.

With the seal gone, remnant forces assaulted Heaven World to everyone’s horror.

The formation was flipped up, nearly leaving its members exposed.

“A supreme overlord?” Everyone saw this thing being far stronger than primal ancestors and heaven-slayers.

Suddenly, things became as still as an image. Mortals and cultivators became frozen due to the involvement of another master.

This person could seal Heaven World in the blink of an eye. A black hole appeared above Corpse Wasteland.

It had enough power to suck in all of Heaven World but didn’t do so. Instead, a shiny, black hoof came out of it and became the center of the world.

It stomped the dragon hybrid; its physical prowess alone could end Heaven World.

“Bam!” It left a hole in the scaled exterior, causing the hybrid to bellow in pain and fall backward.
